selection.edition: international Cin7 Core External API v2
selection.ownership: Cin7 Americas, Inc. (Delaware / Denver, Colorado, United States) with CIN7 LIMITED, Auckland, New Zealand (NZBN 9429047647503). Reviewed edition is the international Cin7 Core External API v2 at inventory.dearsystems.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Cin7 Core API v2 authentication (api-auth-accountid and api-auth-applicationkey headers), GET /me, GET /customer, GET /product, Cin7 Americas Inc / CIN7 LIMITED identity, SOC 2 Type 2 security page, August 2016 historical Cin7 POS/server malware report (Carbanak-linked; founder stated malicious code removed and no surface data loss), and dated incident search (Cin7 Core / DEAR Inventory + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Cin7 Core API compromise identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Cin7 Core account, customer, and product reads provide inventory/ERP access for integration workflows.
exception.incident: August 2016 public report that Carbanak-linked malware ran on Cin7 servers; founder Danny Ing said the code was removed and there did not appear to be data loss.
exception.remediation: Vendor stated the malicious code was removed and the extent of the breach was investigated.
exception.residualRisk: Historical POS/server malware exposure from 2016. Not a current Cin7 Core External API v2 compromise. Live authentication unverified.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /me with api-auth-accountid and api-auth-applicationkey.
Native omits the pinned source Content-Type on GET and the upstream user-agent.
Native category is ecommerce rather than Data/Finance.
Optional page and limit bind to Page and Limit. Name/contact/modifiedSince/include flags are omitted.
Returns raw Cin7 JSON under data; pages are never followed automatically.
Official get is GET /customer?ID= rather than a path segment. Native returns the raw list wrapper under data rather than unwrapping the first record.
POST /customer creates a customer. Native returns raw Cin7 JSON under data.
PUT /customer updates a customer. ID is sent in the JSON body.
Optional page, limit, and name bind to Page, Limit, and Name. SKU/BOM/supplier/movement include flags are omitted.
Returns raw Cin7 JSON under data; pages are never followed automatically.
Official get is GET /product?ID=. Native returns the raw list wrapper under data.
POST /product creates a product. SKU, Name, Category, Type, and CostingMethod are official required fields.
PUT /product updates a product. ID is required in the JSON body.
GET /saleList is the official paginated sale list. Optional Page and Limit bind to query names.
Official get is GET /sale?ID=. Native returns the raw sale document under data.
POST /sale creates a sale. Customer is the official required name field.
GET /purchaseList is the official paginated purchase list.
Official get is GET /purchase?ID=.
GET /supplier lists suppliers. Optional Page and Limit bind to query names.
Official get is GET /supplier?ID=.
POST /supplier creates a supplier.
GET /productAvailability lists on-hand, allocated, and available quantities.
GET /location lists inventory locations.
GET /webhook lists webhook subscriptions. Automation module is required by the vendor.
EventOnly Sale/Created vendor webhook. No HTTP request.
EventOnly Sale/OrderAuthorised vendor webhook. No HTTP request.
EventOnly Customer/Updated vendor webhook. No HTTP request.
EventOnly Product/Updated vendor webhook. No HTTP request.
EventOnly Stock/AvailableStockLevelChanged vendor webhook. No HTTP request.
EventOnly Purchase/Updated vendor webhook. No HTTP request.
